note: Platform control set for AI systems. Where personal data is involved, controls map to DPDPA 2023 sections. Not a legal text.

controls.title: AI systems are registered
controls.objective: Every AI system or AI service in use has an owner, a purpose and a register entry.
controls.evidenceGuidance: AI register entries with owner and purpose.

controls.title: Lawful basis for personal data in AI
controls.objective: AI that processes personal data is covered by a ROPA activity with consent or a s.7 legitimate use.
controls.evidenceGuidance: AI system linked to approved ROPA activities.

controls.title: Minimise personal data sent to AI
controls.objective: Only the personal data the purpose needs reaches the model; identifiers are masked or pseudonymised where possible.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Code scan data map for AI sinks; masking design.

controls.title: AI vendor under contract, no training on customer data
controls.objective: Third-party AI providers act as processors under contract and do not train on the fiduciary's personal data.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Vendor contract / DPA with no-training clause.

controls.title: AI vendor location known
controls.objective: Where the AI provider processes data is known and is not a restricted country.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Vendor country in the recipients register.

controls.title: Human oversight of consequential AI decisions
controls.objective: Decisions with significant effect on people are reviewable and overridable by a human.

controls.title: Accuracy of data used for AI decisions
controls.objective: Personal data used by AI to make decisions about people is complete, accurate and consistent.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Data quality checks, model evaluation results.

controls.title: Impact assessment for high-risk AI
controls.objective: High-risk AI systems have an approved DPIA before deployment.
controls.evidenceGuidance: Approved DPIA linked to the AI system.

controls.title: No profiling or tracking of children by AI
controls.objective: AI is not used for behavioural monitoring, tracking or targeted advertising directed at children.

controls.title: People are told when AI processes their data
controls.objective: Notices describe AI processing of personal data and its purpose.
